show.description: A father branded as a wife killer returns after 10 years in jail… only to find his daughter trapped in abuse, hatred, and painful lies about his past. But Vikram isn’t just an ordinary man, he’s a feared legend ready to destroy anyone who hurts his child. As shocking secrets unfold, can a broken father win back his daughter’s trust before it’s too late?
